en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a Baroque church and adjacent ornate buildings lining a cobbled street with tram tracks. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. At the bottom, printed captions identify the view as in Graz, depicting the Barmherzigen-Kirche and Café "Helm". A vertical imprint along the left edge gives the publisher information from Graz.
